## What's new
- **Links to every service** – every card now has a ↗ button in its title that opens the service's own web UI in a new tab: Radarr, Sonarr, qBittorrent, NZBGet and Seerr cards on the Overview, Downloads, History and Requests tabs
- **Public link per service (optional)** – in **⚙ Settings**, each service has a new *Link in cards* field. Use it when ArrHub talks to a service on an internal address (e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:7878`) but you open it through a reverse proxy (e.g. `https://radarr.example.com`). Empty = the service URL is used. Also available as `RADARR_LINK`, `SONARR_LINK`, `NZBGET_LINK`, `QBIT_LINK`, `SEERR_LINK`.
- Credentials are never put into links – if a service URL contains `user:pass@`, it is stripped from the link

## Fixes
- **NZBGet URLs with credentials** – an NZBGet URL written as `http://user:pass@host:6789` now works (the username and password are sent as a login header instead of failing)

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.7.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.6.3...v1.7.0
